title: Run a container in the background
summary: Starts a container in detached mode with a specific name and port mapping. Useful for running web servers or services.

steps.explain: Starts a container in the background (--detach), assigns it a name, and maps a port from the container to your Mac.

placeholders.name: CONTAINER_NAME
placeholders.description: A name you choose for the container to identify it later.

placeholders.name: IMAGE
placeholders.description: The name of the container image to run.
